name: Palo Brunch Made-to-Order Three-Cheese Omelet & Ham/Cheese Frittata
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Palo / Disney Treasure · Palo Steakhouse (Brunch)
whyItWorks: Fluffy whipped eggs with aged Italian cheeses and diced lean ham provide zero-fiber, high-bioavailability protein.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Three-Cheese Omelet or Ham & Cheese Frittata (skip the Tomato & Onion omelet option to avoid onion fructans) and swap crispy potato hash for a soft white roll if flaring.
watchOuts: Take a Lactaid if unaged fontina/ricotta is included
